brand_identity.name: Unora
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix botanical aesthetics with productivity precision.
Emotion First: Every interaction should feel like a deep breath, not a notification.
Content is King: Typography and negative space drive the narrative.
Zoom In: Focus on the essential details of the plan.
Negative Space: Generous padding to reduce cognitive load.

body.usage: Body text, UI elements, Buttons, Inputs

rules: Use tight tracking (tracking-tight) for headings larger than 24px.
Use relaxed line-height (leading-relaxed) for body text.
Headings should be expressive: use lighter weights (300) for elegance or bold (600) for emphasis.

usage_rules: Do not use pure black (#000000) or pure white (#FFFFFF) for backgrounds.
Primary color is for high-priority actions only (Create, Confirm).
Use 'muted' or 'secondary' for supportive elements to maintain calmness.
Avoid high-saturation colors except for small status indicators.

grid_system.bento_rules: Use 'col-span-full' for hero cards, 'col-span-1' for standard items.

container.alignment: Center aligned on desktop, full width on mobile.

buttons.style: rounded-full px-8 py-6 text-lg font-medium transition-all duration-300

cards.style: rounded-3xl border border-border/50 bg-card shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)] hover:shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.08)] transition-shadow duration-300

inputs.style: rounded-2xl bg-input border-transparent focus:border-primary focus:ring-0 h-14 px-4 text-lg transition-all duration-200

navigation.style: fixed bottom-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/20 shadow-2xl rounded-full px-6 py-3 flex items-center gap-8 z-50

chips.style: rounded-full px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer select-none

universal_guidelines: Do not use generic gradients. Use solid, earthy colors or subtle noise textures.
Do not use Inter for headings. Use Fraunces.
Do not use sharp corners. Use rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl.
Do not use default Shadcn shadows. Use softer, more diffuse shadows.
Ensure all interactive elements have a minimum touch target of 44px.
Use 'sonner' for toasts, not default browser alerts.
Mobile-first: Ensure all key actions are within thumb reach (bottom half of screen).
implementation_steps: Step 1: Setup Tailwind config with new colors and fonts.
Step 2: Create the 'Layout' component with the bottom navigation and page transition wrapper.
Step 3: Build the 'Landing Page' with the hero image and calm typography.
Step 4: Implement 'Google Auth' (mocked or real) and the 'Dashboard'.
Step 5: Build the 'Create Group' flow with the multi-step wizard.
Step 6: Implement the 'Availability Grid' component (critical for the app).
Step 7: Build the 'Plan Display' with the AI suggestion card.
Step 8: Polish with micro-interactions and ensure accessibility.
